name: Conjure Elemental

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: creatures that enter the spirit's space or start their turn within 5 feet of it

summary: A Large elemental spirit grabs creatures near it: Dex save or 8d8 damage of its element and Restrained.
text: Pick air (Lightning), earth (Thunder), fire (Fire) or water (Cold). While it holds no one, a creature entering its space or starting its turn within 5 ft saves; a Restrained creature repeats the save at the start of each of its turns, taking 4d8 more on a failure and breaking free on a success.
